questions.stem: An 18 year old female was sexually assaulted by a male. White stain was present on the clothes of the victim. Barberio’s test was performed on the stains to detect which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
Spermine

Barberio test reaction depends on the presence of spermine which comes from the prostate .



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 434.

questions.stem: Most common mode of inorganic lead poisoning in industrial workers:
questions.solutionHtml:
Inhalation

Most common mode of lead poisoning in industrial workers is by inhalation of fumes and dust of lead.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 544.

questions.stem: In case of sea water drowning, which of the following abnormalities are noted:HypernatremiaHyperkalemiaHemodilutionHyponatremiaMyocardial anoxia Select the correct answer from the given below code:
questions.solutionHtml:
1,5

Sea water drowning causes hypernatremia and myocardial anoxia.

Seawater is hypertonic, it shifts the fluid from blood to alveoli 🡪 Net decrease in blood volume 🡪 hemoconcentration 🡪 Increased viscosity of blood 🡪 Myocardial anoxia.




KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 366,367.

questions.stem: A person in police custody was placed in a prone position with his wrist and ankles bound behind his back and secured with a rope. This method called?
questions.solutionHtml:
Hog-tying
  • The type of physical restraint in which a person is placed in prone position with the wrist and ankles bound behind his back and secured with a rope is known as Hog tying.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 297.

questions.stemHtml: True about burns as shown in image:
questions.solutionHtml:
Seen in lightning
  • The given image shows filigree burns / Lichtenberg’s figures /arborescent markings typical of lightning strike.
  • They are superficial, irregular and tortuous markings that resemble the branches of a tree.Most commonly seen over the shoulders, flanks and front of chest.They represent the path taken by the electrical discharge.
  • If the person survives, they get resolved by themselves by 1 – 2 days.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 334

questions.stem: Female skull brought by the police was analyzed in the forensic department. To consider this as female skull bone which features should be present:Prominent frontal and parietal eminenceNarrow mastoidSmall, smooth glabellaSquare orbitsHeavy cheek bonesSelect the correct answer from the given below code:
questions.solutionHtml:
1, 2 and 3

Prominent frontal and parietal eminence, narrow mastoid and smooth glabella are the features of female skull.
